Name:
🏆 Funny Weed
(prod. Prince Paul)
Notes:
A unreleased 3 feet high and rising track mentioned by Posdnuos during a Yahoo interview explaining there arent many unreleased songs that were made after the album deal that wasn't included this track was scrapped due to the release of Slick Ricks - The Great Adventures of Slick Rick in 1988 which made De La Soul second guess there own album with Posdnuos saying.
"This album was incredible. I looked at what we were doing and was like, ‘We need something else!’ I think that’s why I didn’t finish ‘Funny Weed.’ It was too fast; it was too light-hearted and too in the vein of ‘Three’s the Magic Number"
